narr: An anonymously deep, slow moving low pressure system moved through the Desert Southwest throughout the day on the 4th. The strong forcing for ascent in combination with above normal moisture values resulted in widespread scattered shower activity across much south-central AZ. MUCAPE values upwards of 500 J/KG resulted in pockets of heavier rainfall rates with some training of the shower activity. An area that observed these training of showers was along State Route 238, where pockets of greater than one inch were observed based on radar estimates. The rainfall activity was enough to result in closures of the highway in some sectors due to flooding.
ev: State Route 238 near the intersection with South 99th Avenue in Mobile, AZ was closed due to flooding. Timing estimated from radar. No damages nor injuries were reported.
